summary: Riskified Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of Ronen Assia as an independent director to its Board of Directors, effective June 25, 2026. The Board increased its size to nine members; Assia is a co-founder of eToro Group. This is a routine board appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure. The filing does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. No terms, premium, or deal mechanics are provided.
